parallels.note: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

translations.web: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
translations.bsb: Looking at those seated in a circle around Him, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers!
translations.kjv: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
translations.asv: And looking round on them that sat round about him, he saith, Behold, my mother and my brethren!
